page.title: Free Medicare Tools & Calculators | AltaMedicare
page.description: Free, interactive Medicare calculators: eligibility and enrollment dates, IRMAA premiums, late enrollment penalties, and prescription drug costs.

header.lede: Interactive calculators to help you make informed Medicare decisions — no sign-up, no cost, nothing saved.

library.intro: Built for Utah Medicare beneficiaries and their families.

tools.title: Medicare Eligibility Calculator
tools.desc: Find out when you're eligible and calculate your Initial Enrollment Period.

tools.title: IRMAA Calculator
tools.desc: Estimate your Medicare Part B and Part D premiums based on income.

tools.title: Late Enrollment Penalty Calculator
tools.desc: See whether delaying Medicare could permanently increase your premiums.

tools.title: Drug Cost Calculator
tools.desc: Estimate medication costs and compare lower-cost generic alternatives.

tools.title: Medicare Timeline Calculator
tools.desc: Visualize your enrollment windows and key Medicare deadlines.

tools.title: Enrollment Countdown
tools.desc: A live countdown to your Medicare enrollment deadlines.

tools.title: Medicare Cost Estimator
tools.desc: Estimate your total annual costs and compare coverage options.

tools.title: Formulary Lookup
tools.desc: Search medications to see typical Part D coverage and restrictions.

tools.title: Drug Assistance Finder
tools.desc: Find Extra Help, copay grants, and manufacturer programs that lower medication costs.

tools.title: Medicare Plan Quiz
tools.desc: Answer 7 questions to discover which coverage type may fit you.

tools.title: Medicare Glossary
tools.desc: Search 100+ Medicare terms explained in plain English.

guideHtml: Numbers only tell part of the story. If you want the plain-English version first, start with Medicare basics, compare Medicare Advantage against Medicare Supplement, or read up on Part D drug plans. Just turning 65? The turning 65 guide walks through the deadlines these calculators assume. For quick answers, browse the Medicare FAQ.

cta.text: A licensed Utah agent can walk you through any of these numbers — free, no pressure.
